omitted.packages/chord/src/sqlite/cloudflare.ts: a host adapter (Durable Object storage); it comes with the hosting adapters after spec 049 slice 3
omitted.packages/chord/src/sqlite/index.ts: the barrel; src/index.ts exports the port

src/facade/database.ts.deviation: the port serves SQLite and Postgres: the types are named Db, DbExecutor and SqlValue (spec 049), run resolves { changes }, and close is the provider's, not on the port

src/facade/migrations.ts.deviation: named for both databases (applyMigrations, Migration, messages without SQLite); the bookkeeping SQL is portable to Postgres (no STRICT, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, the version written as a checked integer) and the stored version is read as a number

src/facade/schema.ts.deviation: named for both databases (validateSchemaPrefix, messages without SQLite)
